status_reason: The chair-reviewed BCA-area of interest, exact 2 km release AOI rule, retained SSSI context, bounded incident chronology, EFFIS event match, selected observations, licence snapshots and fail-closed AOI-level scene QA are approved for controlled manual releases.

area_of_interest.rule: Preserve the canonical core separately; derive the release-wide AOI by transforming it to EPSG:27700 and buffering by exactly 2000 metres. Rebuild every AOI-dependent input and output for a new core version.
area_of_interest.limitations: The core is a BCA-defined approximate landscape area, not the legal, official, surveyed or current boundary of Blorenge Common CL18. The Blorenge SSSI remains a separate authoritative context layer.

sources.transformation: Preserve the canonical polygon unchanged; derive the release AOI only by transforming to EPSG:27700 and applying an exact 2000 metre buffer.

contract.retention: Retain every canonical version and raw reviewed capture used by a published release.
contract.withdrawal: Withdraw affected releases without substituting another geometry or weakening the boundary limitation.

sources.title: Copernicus Sentinel-2 Collection-1 Level-2A
sources.purpose: Primary source observations for provisional extent and continuous dNBR, NDVI and NDMI change evidence.

acquisition.method: CDSE STAC identity verification followed by anonymous Earth Search Collection-1 COG retrieval with both identities and exact checksums retained

scene_qa.mask: SCL classes 0,1,2,3,8,9,10,11 invalid with one 20 m adjacency pixel
scene_qa.postreport_role: Earliest observation passing the 95% core-and-comparison gate and latest suitable observation available at release time; it is not labelled after the fire ended.

upstream.refresh_policy: Re-query weekly while evidence is active, then quarterly; check product deletion, anomaly and reprocessing notices before every promotion.

schema.nodata: SCL and product masks; preserve explicit not-observed state

sources.transformation: Apply provider scale and offset, per-pixel masks and disclosed adjacency dilation; retain native analytic support; assess terrain shadow; compute continuous indicators; preserve observation date and contributing count per pixel.
known_gaps: The first passing post-report observation is 11 August 2026, 22 days after the first report; earlier candidates remain not observed rather than cloud-filled.
The 11 August observation is both the earliest passing post-report scene and the latest suitable scene available at release time.
Whole-tile cloud percentage is discovery metadata, not AOI acceptance evidence.

contract.temporal_role: pre-fire, immediate-post and latest suitable observations
contract.retention: Retain exact item metadata, contributing bands, masks and private COGs for each published evidence release.
contract.withdrawal: Withdraw public evidence without silently substituting observations; preserve lineage where lawful.

sources.title: EFFIS Rapid Damage Assessment burnt areas
sources.purpose: Historic checksum-pinned provisional provider boundary retained from release one, with a current geometry-identical feature recorded only as BCA-inferred corroboration.
sources.provider: European Commission Joint Research Centre, EFFIS

acquisition.method: Retain the complete checksum-pinned 13 August WFS 1.1 GeoJSON response as canonical historic evidence; retain the complete 21 August bounded response separately as current corroboration

upstream.cadence: historic evidence is immutable; current-season corroboration was a one-time reviewed snapshot
upstream.refresh_policy: Fail closed if either reviewed response checksum changes. Any later live WFS identity or geometry change requires a new manual source decision.

licence.attribution: European Union, Copernicus EFFIS; changes and clipping by Blorenge Commoners Association indicated

sources.transformation: Extract historic id 592404 from the complete release-one response, preserve every provider field, and clip only a display copy. Verify current id 627416 is coordinate-identical with only id, LASTUPDATE and rolling CLASS changed; label that relationship BCA-inferred-rekey, exclude unrelated id 627417, and never claim a provider crosswalk or fresh reacquisition of 592404.
known_gaps: EFFIS no longer returns historic feature 592404 and publishes no public archive, feature history or old-to-new id crosswalk.
Geometry-identical current feature 627416 is compelling corroboration but its relationship to 592404 is a BCA inference, not an EFFIS-declared successor.
Current feature 627417 describes a separate August event and is excluded.
EFFIS dates are provider product dates, not verified ignition, control or extinction times.
EFFIS does not distinguish wildfire from prescribed or environmental burning and may omit small islands or scars.

contract.retention: Retain the complete historic response and current corroborating response with their exact checksums and retrieval metadata.
contract.withdrawal: Withdraw or supersede the provisional layer without relabelling another boundary as equivalent.

deferred_enhancements.required_evidence: SWFRS incident identifier, authoritative control or containment and stop times, and any reusable surveyed or operational perimeter.
deferred_enhancements.presentation_constraint: Until obtained, use only the bounded first-report and ongoing-response chronology and never label EFFIS FINALDATE as the end of the incident.
